COLORING PAGE · SHAPES · AGE 2+

Triangle & House Coloring Page

A printable triangle coloring page for 2-year-olds: an upside-down triangle shape and a little house with a triangle roof to color and talk about.

THE COLORING PAGE

The full picture, exactly as the artist drew it.

See the whole picture, download the original file or print it clean — just the picture, no buttons or banners. Want to color it right now on this screen? Start coloring online — same picture, drawing layer included.

← Tall TrianglePrevious coloring pageSandwich & Mountain →Next coloring page
HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Spot them

    One triangle points DOWN, and one sits on the house as a roof.

  2. 2

    Color the house

    Color the roof and the walls — what color is your house?

  3. 3

    Color the top shape

    The pointy-down shape looks like a slice of pizza — yum!

WHERE THIS FITS

The class behind it.

This page belongs to Class 9 — Colors and Shapes (Age 2) on the Learning Path, and the whole collection lives at /coloring-pages/shapes/. Print it, color it together, and let the fridge door be the gallery.
